abort.no_devices_found: No Neewer WiFi lights were found on your network

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the light. Ensure it is on WiFi and not controlled by another app.
error.cannot_determine_client_ip: Home Assistant has no route to {host}. Add an adapter on the light's subnet, or a route to that subnet via its router.
error.host_unreachable: No route from Home Assistant ({client_ip}) to {host}. Check the route to the light's subnet and that the router forwards traffic to it.
error.invalid_subnet: Invalid subnet. Use CIDR notation such as 192.168.103.0/24
error.no_devices_found: No Neewer WiFi lights were discovered. Enter a subnet below or try manual setup.
error.no_response: No reply from {host}. The light gives no feedback when it ignores a request, so check: it is powered on and on WiFi, no other app is controlling it, UDP port 5052 is allowed both ways, and (on a routed subnet) the light sees packets coming from {client_ip} — the handshake embeds this IP and the light ignores mismatches, e.g. after NAT.
error.port_in_use: UDP port {port} is already in use on the Home Assistant host. Close the Neewer app or any other integration using it, then retry.

discover.title: Discover Neewer WiFi lights
discover.description: Scanning may take up to 30 seconds on large networks. If nothing is found, enter a subnet to scan (for example 192.168.103.0/24).
